programmes.d: The team venture into a cottage where it is said ‘no living soul can endure living there’. With cursed dolls, murder and suicide this derelict place has everything to fear, and the team were not disappointed.

We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The foreboding Codnor Castle Cottage maintains its attack on the Most Haunted team with dramatic effect causing Yvette calls an early end to their night in Hell House.
Yvette takes her team to a disused prison in Birmingham which has housed some of the most notorious criminals in British history.

The ruins that make up Dudley Castle house a plethora of paranormal activity for Yvette and her team to investigate. Strange noises and a violent poltergeist await them as they turn the lights out and do battle with the unseen forces that resided there.
Workhouses were not the best of places to be, so why would anyone stay after they had died? Yvette takes her team on a memorable journey to find out.
Whatever was making itself known to the team earlier, continues in this episode as something seems to be following Yvette from the shadows.
Yvette takes the Most Haunted team into the very haunted, disused attic at the top of this huge country mansion and are soon made to feel very unwelcome.

This time Yvette and her team ventures into the dark abyss of the cellars under this large country house. Without exception every member of the team experience something unexplained as the darkness starts to come to life.
This episode features the following cases: The Wrestler, The Escape, Dead Friday, Ghost Visitor, The Lady in a Black Dress.
This episode features the following cases: Morning Sickness, The Curse of Hampton Manor, Wax Executioner, Blood Bank, Ring Toss.
This episode features the following cases: Devil's Tattoo, Static Man, The Bloody Hand, Where Have All the Heroes Gone, War Surplus.
This episode features the following cases: Moonstruck Beach, Healing Hands, Aspen Sunny Side, Night Walker, Hot Car.
This episode features the following cases: The Viewing, The Subway, Kid in the Closet, Justice is Served, The Tractor.
NFL great, Eric Dickerson fears that there are spirits in his Calabasas, California home tormenting his children.
Legendary actor, Kevin Sorbo returns to an idyllic lake in Texas where he encountered a ghostly apparition so disturbing it haunts him to this day.
Actor and musician, Eric Balfour, returns to a notoriously haunted abandoned hotel in rural Texas where he and friends were attacked and driven out by paranormal forces.
Legendary hip-hop artist, Tionne "T-Boz" Watkins (TLC), returns to the California condo where paranormal activity drove her and her family out only months before.

Beloved actor, Ernie Hudson returns to the remote mountain lodge in Arizona where he and his family encountered a terrifying supernatural force during the promotion of the original Ghostbusters movie.
Actress and glamour icon, Morgan Fairchild seeks closure on the haunting events, both real and paranormal, that drove her from her ex-husband's home in Dallas more than 40 years ago.
The ghost of a murdered bride haunts Joey Lawrence and his family at the Pfister Hotel. Gabrielle Carteris is guided through a difficult time by her late grandfather's spirit.
After the tragic loss of her father, Cheri Oteri visits a medium who channels his spirit from the other side.

Yvette heads to Tamworth and a beautiful manor house that is said to be filled with paranormal occurrences. Almost as soon as the team get there something seems to want to make itself known with dramatic effect.
The team continue their investigation into the Moat House and some regret that decision as objects fly and a little girls doll seems to tell a tale.
Karl enters a Masonic Temple alone, seeking the truth behind its eerie reputation. The mysterious world of Freemasonry soon reveals a chilling presence in the shadows.
Cameras are left locked-off in haunted sites across the country, capturing chilling activity in a bold experiment with some truly remarkable results.
Karl enters the formidable HMP Gloucester and sets up an experiment with some amazing results.
Karl and Stuart explore Birmingham's Coffin Works, a hotspot of eerie activity. On the top floor, where burial shrouds were made, something unseen seems keen on making tea.
With Karl on the top floor, Stuart investigates the first floor of this very haunted building and something in the office seems to want to make itself known.
The attic space of Hodroyd Hall is one of the properties most haunted areas and Karl & Stuart venture into the darkness to find out what haunts this atmospheric place.
